in_hebrew.name: Oceana
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of the sea
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Oceana הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Oceana is the goddess of the sea. Her name derives from the Greek word 'okeanos', which means 'ocean' or 'sea'. She is often depicted as a beautiful, statuesque woman with long, flowing hair and a crown of coral and pearls. Oceana is a nurturing and powerful deity, who is said to protect and provide for all marine life.
